outline.dat in this drawer is built from the icon font (package/font/lucide.ttf) by tools/gen_lucide_icons.py
over dist/lucide-icons-outline: the glyphs rendered to 32x32 and 32x16 planar images. Amarchy splices them into the
.info files when the flat look is on (UP-Term:Amarchy/Icons/outline.dat) when the icon style is Outline.
